name: Kida Mikihiko
source:
Kenta's companion, nicknamed “The Intellectual”.

He is knowledgeable and studious.

He has an inquisitive mind and is always looking for ways to find out what he is curious about,  and is the brain of the "Big Sis Hunters".

By the way, she doesn't like to go to the beach because she gets sunburned easily.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=914256]getchu[/url]]
